name: zgeometry_weiler_build_point_side_tables_for_contour_pair
description: zGeometry_Weiler::BuildPointSideTablesForContourPair fills the contour A versus B edge side table and the contour B versus A edge side table.
known_limits: Binary Ninja has a documented next-vertex rendering limitation in the table loops. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x468470 validates the two side-table fill passes and duplicate first-column sentinel at the end of each edge row.
The native clip leaf smoke verifies both side tables for a two-edge A/B contour pair, including row-closing sentinel values.
